description: A clear, small change: do it without unnecessary questions, with the tests passing.

steps.prompt: Add a subtract function to calc.py, with a test.

checks.name: tests pass, including a subtract test
checks.run: python3 -m unittest -v test_calc 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_subtract' && python3 -m unittest -q test_calc

checks.name: subtract works
checks.run: python3 -c 'from calc import subtract; assert subtract(5, 3) == 2 and subtract(2, 7) == -5'
